{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk blend sheath dress in a deep emerald green (#0f3d3e) with a subtle woven texture, falling to the knee with a slight A-line cut that flatters the waistline.
Gold-tone pointed-toe pumps with a moderate stiletto heel to elongate the legs and match the skin tones.
Delicate gold drop earrings and a slim pearl bracelet to add sparkle without overwhelming the neckline.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn wedding at an upscale restaurant because the rich emerald green honors the season while remaining elegant enough for the formal dress code. The knee-length cut strikes the right balance between modesty and sophistication, ensuring she feels comfortable during lunch but looks polished for the ceremony. The gold accessories complement her natural skin tones, tying together the refined look of a thoughtful wedding guest."}
